moves.label: American Dragon Jab
moves.description: Fast human-form check that starts Jake's close pressure.

moves.label: Skate Park Low
moves.description: Low crouching strike that ducks under highs and keeps Jake near the opponent.

moves.label: Dragon Claw Check
moves.description: Compact red-aura claw swipe with better reward than his fastest jab.

moves.label: Dragon Tail Spark
moves.description: Forward red-aura swing that cashes out basic human strings.

jableft.label: American Dragon Jab
jableft.description: Fast human-form jab for checking movement and starting pressure.

jabright.label: Dragon Claw Check
jabright.description: Quick red-aura mid swipe that keeps Jake close enough to keep talking with his fists.

kickleft.label: Skate Park Low
kickleft.description: Crouching low that slips under highs and leaves Jake in full crouch.

kickright.label: Dragon Tail Spark
kickright.description: Forward red-aura swing with enough advantage to keep pressure honest.

cmd:f+1.label: Claw Dash
cmd:f+1.description: Forward-moving claw strike that reaches farther than Jake's standing checks.

cmd:f+3.label: Skateboard Shoulder
cmd:f+3.description: Committed skateboard approach that catches backdash attempts but is punishable on block.

cmd:d+3.label: Crouching Dragon Sweep
cmd:d+3.description: Low crouching swipe that keeps Jake compact and threatens crouch routes.

cmd:d/f+2.label: Rising Dragon Claw
cmd:d/f+2.description: Unsafe rising claw that starts Jake's juggle routes.

cmd:d/f+3.label: Airborne Talon
cmd:d/f+3.description: Jumping talon hit that lifts slightly and keeps aerial pressure moving.

cmd:qcf+3.label: Dragon Rush
cmd:qcf+3.description: Red-aura rush that carries forward and catches retreat.

cmd:qcf+4.label: Full Dragon Pounce
cmd:qcf+4.description: Dragon-form pounce that works as a high-commitment juggle extender.

cmd:WS+4.label: Rising Skate Kick
cmd:WS+4.description: While-standing kick that lifts after crouch pressure.

cmd:FC+1.label: Crouch Claw Poke
cmd:FC+1.description: Quick crouching poke for interrupting after Skate Park Low.

cmd:FC+2.label: Low Dragon Pop
cmd:FC+2.description: Crouch-starting launcher that rewards a hard read from full crouch.

cmd:1+2.label: Claw Flare Barrage
cmd:1+2.description: Red-aura barrage that keeps Jake close for route extensions.

cmd:1+3.label: Dragon Morph Lift
cmd:1+3.description: Transformation starter that launches but leaves Jake very punishable on block.

cmd:2+3.label: Board Flip Feint
cmd:2+3.description: Skateboard low feint that slips into crouch and punishes stand blocking.

cmd:2+4.label: Skateboard Knockdown
cmd:2+4.description: Risky low skateboard sweep that knocks down on commitment.

cmd:3+4.label: Dragon Cyclone
cmd:3+4.description: Dragon-form spin that creates tornado routes after a launcher.

cmd:SS+3.label: Skate Side Slash
cmd:SS+3.description: Sidestep skateboard slash that catches linear retaliation and keeps Jake mobile.

cmd:O+1.label: Dragon Up
cmd:O+1.description: Ki-cost transformation burst that armors through light checks before Jake morphs forward.

cmd:O+2.label: American Dragon Fire Breath
cmd:O+2.description: Expensive dragon fire finisher with strong juggle reward and real block risk.
